$schema_note: Every music agent across the ecosystem. Field conventions follow agentic-intelligence-system (AIS) agents.json style. canonical_source paths resolve relative to a side-by-side clone layout (all repos under one parent dir). portable=true means tools/export-agents.mjs emits it to exports/.

agents.name: Lyric Writer
agents.summary: Master-level lyric craft consuming skills/lyric-craft: rewrite protocol, mandatory anti-slop gate, English/mythic/hybrid register selection from the Guardian brief, explicit output contract, Suno-ready formatting.

agents.name: Film & Sync Composer
agents.summary: Score and sync thinking: brief decoding, cue design, spotting, sync-licensing readiness.

agents.name: Music Theory Teacher
agents.summary: The language of music taught through what the student is already making — intervals to orchestration, AI-era native.

agents.name: Orchestration Architect
agents.summary: Orchestral arrangement and ensemble writing: voicing, register, density, doubling, and AI-prompt translation of orchestral intent.

agents.name: Music Producer
agents.summary: Top-level music production orchestrator: composes catalog, mastery, prompt, QC, licensing, release specialists.

agents.name: Suno Prompt Architect
agents.summary: 3-variant Suno prompts (anchor/paraphrase/contrarian), 200-char ceiling, style stacking.

agents.name: Suno Mastery (genre specialist)
agents.summary: Genre-specific production briefs across 12+ styles.

agents.name: Music Create Wizard
agents.summary: Guided multi-step Suno creation flow (repo-internal draft persistence).

agents.name: Music Catalog Indexer
agents.summary: Source-of-truth indexer for the 12k+ song catalog (repo-internal data paths).

agents.name: Mastering QC
agents.summary: Loudness/quality gate: -14 LUFS targeting, true-peak, DR via ffmpeg loudnorm + ebur128.

agents.name: Music Licensing
agents.summary: Use-case → license classification, platform ToS lookup, template emission.

agents.name: Music Release Manager
agents.summary: Release pipeline across Distrokid/Spotify/Apple/YouTube with QC + licensing gates (repo-internal dispatch).

agents.name: Music Video Batch
agents.summary: Batch lyric-video generation via Remotion (repo-internal render pipeline).

agents.name: Sound Composition
agents.summary: Composition sub-system of the public sound-intelligence vertical (arrange, demo, lyric, score, transition commands).

agents.name: Sound Production
agents.summary: Production sub-system: mix plan, master plan, vocal chain, sound design, recall.

agents.name: Sound Catalog
agents.summary: Catalog sub-system: metadata pack, ISRC mint, release plan, version map, deplatform recovery.

agents.name: Sound Performance
agents.summary: Performance sub-system: set design, live mix, broadcast prep, residency, audience contract.

agents.name: Sound Audience
agents.summary: Audience sub-system: cohort map, list architecture, ritual design, sovereign publish.

agents.name: Sound Sync

agents.name: Music Curator (A&R gate)
agents.summary: A&R quality gate of the operated label vertical.

agents.name: Music Archivist
agents.summary: Label catalog archivist.

agents.name: Persona Keeper
agents.summary: Artist-persona spawning and continuity.

agents.name: Music Producer (label)
agents.summary: Label-side asset generation.

agents.name: Music Distributor
agents.summary: Distribution operations.

agents.name: Music Amplifier
agents.summary: Amplification/promotion operations.

agents.name: Royalty Architect

agents.name: Vibe OS Master

agents.name: Teaching Assistant (5 personas)
agents.summary: Music education assistant with 5 selectable teacher personas (Aria, Max, Sage, Vega, Luna).

agents.name: Academy Music Producer
agents.summary: AI music production coach: prompt engineering, genre technique, arrangement feedback.

agents.name: Academy Content Creator
agents.summary: Lesson and course content generator for music education.

agents.name: ACOS Music Production
agents.summary: Education-focused music production agent (AI Music Academy content + Suno mastery + licensing).

agents.name: Swarm Orchestrator
agents.summary: Routes any music/vibe ask to the right ecosystem agent(s) and tool(s) across all 6 repos, grounded in registry/agents.json and registry/tools.json. Pairs with tools/swarm-router.mjs for deterministic keyword-overlap scoring.

agents.name: music-album-orchestrator
agents.summary: Top-level ALBUM orchestrator — composes the 9 Pillar-2 music agents + hub album tooling into an intake-to-release flow. Runs /album (ingest/sequence/status/release). Starts where a track is rendered, ends album-ready.

agents.name: music-brief-writer
agents.summary: Module 8 hinge — turns an approved Suno sidecar into a build-ready brief with per-asset engine routing (per MEDIA-TOOLING-DOCTRINE), audio-measured fields, and human-gated Guardian binding.

agents.name: music-mission-control
agents.summary: Daily operator (/daily-music) — reads the track-state spine, pending gates, and album completeness into TODAY'S MISSION (max 3 music + 2 content, leverage-ordered), dispatches picks, logs reflection for tomorrow.
